name: Austria
blurb: Imperial cities, classical music and Alpine villages.
cities: Vienna
Palaces, coffee houses and world-class concerts.
Salzburg
Mozart's baroque birthplace beneath the Alps.
Hallstatt
Lakeside village beneath steep Alpine peaks.
Innsbruck
An Alpine city with slopes a cable car ride away.
Wachau Valley
Apricot orchards, vineyards and abbeys on the Danube.
Graz
A red-roofed old town, the Schlossberg clock tower and the Baroque Schloss Eggenberg.
Lake Neusiedl (Austria)
Reed-fringed steppe lake with wine villages, cycling paths and storks on the chimneys.
Carnuntum (Danube Limes)
A reconstructed Roman frontier city on the Danube east of Vienna.
Schönbrunn Palace
The Habsburgs' 1,441-room summer palace, with formal gardens and the world's oldest zoo.
Attersee & Mondsee Pile Dwellings
Prehistoric lakeside settlements beneath clear Alpine lakes in the Salzkammergut.
Semmering Railway
A 19th-century mountain railway of viaducts and tunnels through the Alps.
Baden bei Wien
A Biedermeier spa town with thermal baths, a casino and vineyards.
